message.content:
Desserts come in a rainbow of colors—almost as varied as their flavors! Here’s a quick palette of some common ones:

| Dessert | Typical Color(s) | Why it looks that way |
|---------|------------------|-----------------------|
| Chocolate cake / brownies | Dark brown | Cocoa powder or melted chocolate |
| Vanilla custard / crème brûlée | Creamy white | Milk, eggs, sugar |
| Strawberry shortcake | Pinkish‑red | Fresh strawberries |
| Lemon meringue pie | Yellow & white | Lemon curd + whipped egg whites |
| Blueberry cheesecake | Light purple/blue | Blueberries |
| Carrot cake | Orange | Grated carrots, orange food coloring |
| Tiramisu | Beige | Espresso‑soaked ladyfingers, mascarpone |
| Fruit tart | Multicolored | Assorted fresh fruit |

If you have a specific dessert in mind, let me know and I can give you its exact hue!
